# cozystack_kubernetes_nodes (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack Kubernetes worker node pool by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_kubernetes_nodes" "gpu" {
  name      = "demo-gpu"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Node pool name (`<cluster>-<pool>`).
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `cluster` (String) Parent Kubernetes cluster the pool attaches to.
- `disk_size` (String) System disk size for each worker VM.
- `gpus` (Attributes List) GPUs attached to each node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpus))
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `images` (Attributes) Image overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type.
- `kubelet` (Attributes) Kubelet resource reservations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubelet))
- `max_replicas` (Number) Maximum number of nodes.
- `max_unhealthy` (String) Unhealthy-node budget before remediation pauses.
- `min_replicas` (Number) Minimum number of nodes.
- `node_startup_timeout` (String) Machine startup budget before remediation.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU and memory per node, when set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `roles` (List of String) Node roles.
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass for the worker node system disks.
- `talos` (Attributes) Talos worker image configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--talos))
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version the pool joins.

<a id="nestedatt--gpus"></a>

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.

- `kube_reserved_cpu` (String) CPU reserved for kubelet and the container runtime.
- `kube_reserved_memory` (String) Memory reserved for kubelet and the container runtime.
- `system_reserved_cpu` (String) CPU reserved for the host OS.
- `system_reserved_memory` (String) Memory reserved for the host OS.
